message.content:
I don’t have access to live market feeds, so I can’t give you the exact price right now.  
If you need the most up‑to‑date Bitcoin price, you can check:

* **Cryptocurrency exchanges** (e.g., Coinbase, Binance, Kraken) – they display the current spot price on their homepages.  
* **Financial news sites** (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters, CNBC) – they often show a live ticker.  
* **Crypto price aggregators** (e.g., CoinMarketCap, CoinGecko, CryptoCompare) – these sites pull data from multiple exchanges and update every few seconds.  
* **APIs** – if you’re building an app, you can use an API such as the CoinGecko public API (`https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/simple/price?ids=bitcoin&vs_currencies=usd`) or the CoinMarketCap API (requires an API key).

Just pick one of those sources and you’ll see the current price in USD (or your preferred currency).
